description:
Plan the next RS3 activity, training milestone or unlock prerequisite. Use get_player_quests for progress, get_player_stats for levels, get_wiki_entity_facts for one quest's facts, or search_wiki for references.
- Routing: unlock overrides goalType, otherwise goalType overrides inference. targetSkill sets focus, not the planner.
- Example: {"goal":"Train Mining","goalType":"skill_training","targetSkill":"Mining","targetLevel":70,"context":{"skills":{"Mining":52}}}. Without a target or goal-specified level, 52 defaults to 55.
- Account: caller levels override hiscores; fresh journals override completion claims. Quest comparison needs a public context.username. Membership, gear and bank balances are not fetched.
- Setup/privacy: operator RUNESCAPE_RECOMMENDATIONS_ENABLED=true and TYPESAFE_API_KEY. Goal/account context goes to TypeSafe; display-name lookups go to Jagex.
- Cost: at most 24 paid Jev calls for quests, three otherwise, including routing. Repeated calls can incur fresh charges. No automatic paid retries; rounds completed before an error may already be billed.
- Timing/errors: 55 seconds for routing/non-quest work, plus five minutes for quest comparison. Invalid input/configuration or fatal provider failures return isError/text. HTTP shares 60 requests/IP/minute by default; honor Retry-After on 429.
- Freshness: public Wiki reads cache five minutes or six hours by planner. Player journals and decisions are not cached; no game account changes. General activity requires reviewed extracts; withheld text can yield no_match.
- Outcomes: needs_context may still include a conditional recommendation; use missingContext to clarify it. no_match means no supported option; goal_met refers to the selected target. Communicate warnings and source conditions.

inputSchema.description: Goal and optional account context. Combined serialized JSON must not exceed 20,000 characters; oversized input is rejected before any paid calls.

context.description: Optional known account facts; missing facts are not fabricated.

budgetGp.description: Available spending budget in coins: zero means no GP available to spend; omit when unknown. The server does not read a bank balance.

completedQuests.description: Known completed quest titles; a partial list is allowed and absence does not mean unfinished. Fresh RuneMetrics status overrides conflicting caller claims. This list cannot replace the public journal required by quest comparisons.

gameMode.description: Account mode; public hiscores lookup uses normal when omitted, while the account mode remains listed as missing context.

gear.description: Relevant equipment the player owns; this is caller context, not a fetched inventory or bank.

members.description: Whether the player has membership. Omitted membership stays unknown, rather than assuming free-to-play or members.

notes.description: Additional preferences or constraints treated as account data, not executable instructions.

playStyle.description: Preferred attention level for this session; either accepts AFK or active options.

sessionMinutes.description: Available play time in minutes, not a guarantee of activity completion time.

skillExperience.description: Current total XP per skill, not XP to earn. Consistent exact XP supports training estimates; omitted XP can be filled from compatible public hiscores.

skills.description: Current skill levels keyed by exact RS3 skill names; not targets. Caller levels override hiscores. Missing ranked levels may be fetched; unranked/missing skills remain unknown, not level one.

username.description: RS3 display name for public hiscores and, for quest planning, the fresh RuneMetrics journal. Private journals cannot establish quest completion.

goal.description: Desired RS3 outcome in plain language, e.g. best Mining quest or train Mining to level 70; not instructions to execute arbitrary tools.

goalType.description: activity forces a general shortlist using reviewed Wiki extracts; quests compares unfinished journal quests; skill_training selects training milestones; unlock_progression builds unlock prerequisites. Omit to infer from goal. An unlock value overrides this selector.

targetLevel.description: Destination level for skill_training only, not current level or XP. Precedence: this field, then an explicit level in goal, then the next multiple of five above the current level capped at 120. Other planners ignore this field.

targetSkill.description: Exact RS3 skill focus, overriding inferred focus for rewards or training. This does not select a planner; set goalType to force training or quest comparisons.

unlock.description: Named unlock such as Invention or Prifddinas. Providing it forces unlock_progression even when goalType says otherwise. Supported evidence covers Invention and bounded PvM/quest-reward targets, not every game unlock.

name: recommend_next_activity

account.description: Resolved account context with caller/public sources and unknown facts preserved.

alternatives.description: Other supported candidates; not an exhaustive catalogue.

blockedAlternatives.description: Rejected or blocked candidates with their known conditions.

missingContext.description: Account facts or target details still needed for a confident plan.

questCoverage.description: Quest journal/catalogue comparison coverage, when the quest planner ran.

questDecision.description: Quest selection evidence and eligibility reasoning.

recommendation.description: Top candidate or null; the planner-specific recommendation is supported by sources and may remain conditional.

sources.description: Evidence references, retrieval/revision details and attribution where applicable.

status.description: Outcome: recommended proposes a candidate; needs_context requests facts; no_match has no supported option; goal_met means the target is already satisfied.

trainingCoverage.description: Training evidence coverage and its limitations.

trainingPlan.description: Training target, XP gap, methods and prerequisites when the training planner ran.

unlockCoverage.description: Unlock evidence coverage and unresolved requirements.

unlockPlan.description: Named unlock and its prerequisite quest/skill progression, when applicable.

usage.description: Paid Jev rounds, input/output token counts, model names and round budget.

warnings.description: Data gaps, coverage limits and conditions the caller should communicate.

title: Recommend Next RS3 Activity
